invention.ref: Robert Victor Neher patented the continuous rolling process for aluminum foil in Switzerland
invention.ref_zh: 罗伯特·维克多·内埃在瑞士获得铝箔连续延压工艺专利

patent.ref: Swiss Patent 49,634 granted to Robert Victor Neher for aluminum foil rolling
patent.ref_zh: 内埃获得瑞士铝箔延压专利第49,634号

mass_production.ref: Neher opened a rolling mill in Kreuzlingen; Toblerone began wrapping chocolate bars in foil
mass_production.ref_zh: 内埃在克罗伊茨林根设厂投产，三角巧克力率先采用铝箔包装

popularization.ref: Reynolds Metals introduced Reynolds Wrap in the US, popularizing household aluminum foil
popularization.ref_zh: 雷诺兹金属在美国推出 Reynolds Wrap 铝箔卷，迅速普及为厨房日用品

locations.place_label_zh: 瑞士图尔高州克罗伊茨林根（内埃连续延压铝箔厂）
locations.place_label_en: Kreuzlingen, Thurgau, Switzerland (Neher aluminum foil rolling mill)

locations.place_label_zh: 美国弗吉尼亚州里士满（雷诺兹家用铝箔卷）
locations.place_label_en: Richmond, Virginia, USA (Reynolds Wrap household foil)

sources.title: The Story of Aluminum Foil — The Aluminum Association

summary_zh: 铝箔是由高纯度铝压延制成的轻薄金属箔。1910年内埃在瑞士发明连续压延法并用于巧克力防潮包装，1947年雷诺兹推出家用箔卷，如今广泛用于食品烘烤、储鲜与日用遮蔽。
summary_en: Rolled into thin metal sheets, aluminum foil was patented by Neher in Switzerland in 1910; Reynolds Metals introduced household rolls in 1947, making it a kitchen and packaging staple.

image.alt_en: An unrolled sheet of kitchen aluminum foil
